description:
Ready…Set… Build your ultimate BMX race bike with the Title Team frame by Mongoose. Designed for intermediate to advanced riders, this frame features Full Tectonic T1 biaxial hydroformed and butted aluminum construction with disc brake mounts. 86mm BB shell and tapered headtube delivers superior performance, while internal cable routing protects your cables while providing a clean, streamlined look. Race to the podium on the Mongoose Title Team.
Constructed from Tectonic T1 biaxial hydroformed and butted aluminum with internal cable routing.
86mm BB shell and tapered headtube delivers superior performance. 3D forged with 10 mm dropout and rear disc brake mount. (140mm rotor compatible)
Frame comes supplied with sealed bearing headset with crown race adapter in 2 sizes fitting 1.5” or 1 1/8” steerer.
21.25" top tube length and frame weight of 4.0 lbs.
